sloka: स मम अदर्शनात् दीनो बाल्यात् प्रभृति लालितः ।तटाक इव पीतांबुः उपशोषम् गमिष्यति ॥४-१८-५१॥
transliteration: sa mama adarśanāt dīno bālyāt prabhṛti lālitaḥ ।taṭāka iva pītāṁbuḥ upaśoṣam gamiṣyati ॥4-18-51॥

translations.english: 'I neither grieve for myself nor for Tara nor for my kinsmen. But I do for my son Angada adorned with golden armlets. He is embellished with all virtues.
